title: Helmert sub-matrix — helmert_submatrix
text: full Helmert matrix \(H^F\) k x k orthogonal matrix first row \((1/\sqrt{k}, \dots, 1/\sqrt{k})\) , \(j \ge 2\), jth row \((-1, \dots, -1, j-1, 0, \dots, 0)/\sqrt{j(j-1)}\) entry \(j-1\) occurs column \(j\). Dropping first row yields Helmert sub-matrix \(H\). text: statistic \(H = \sum u^p / (\sum u^p + \sum w^p)\), \(u\) nearest-neighbor distances \(m\) artificial points data \(w\) \(m\) sampled data points data. Large values indicate clustering. null = "tangent", artificial points come unimodal Gaussian mean covariance Procrustes-aligned data coordinates (centered, unit-size configurations rotated onto Procrustes mean), distances Euclidean coordinates. tests unimodality clustering. null = "uniform", artificial points uniform shape space (Gaussian landmarks) distances distance. uniform null rejects concentrated sample, clustered , says nothing clusters. p-value assume \(H = 0.5\). title: ShapeClust 0.3.0
text: shape_rankkmed() now follows Zadegan et al. (2013) implemented kmed::rankkmed(): hostility computed m nearest objects medoid, colliding medoids relocated random objects outside every group. Previously hostility summed whole assigned cluster, constant whenever cluster consists mutual nearest neighbours, update picked lowest-indexed member; relocation step existed. Partitions now equal kmed::rankkmed() distances random stream (tested). bagclust1() now lets every replicate label n observations nearest bootstrap medoid, Dudoit Fridlyand (2003). Previously -bag observations (63%) voted replicate. select_K(method = "gap") drew null reference permuting rows columns distance matrix, leaves clustering problem unchanged made gap close zero every K. reference now uniform sample shape space, K chosen one-standard- error rule Tibshirani et al. (2001). gap needs pre-shapes, distances. riemannian_variances() now uses full Procrustes means (Kent 1994) instead sample medoid, longer claims use ‘shapes’.
